sloka: स तैः बाणैः महावीर्यः पूर्ण मुक्तैः अजिह्म गैः ।बिभेद निशितैः तीक्ष्णैः गृध्रम् घोरैः शिली मुखैः ॥३-५१-८॥
transliteration: sa taiḥ bāṇaiḥ mahāvīryaḥ pūrṇa muktaiḥ ajihma gaiḥ ।bibheda niśitaiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ gṛdhram ghoraiḥ śilī mukhaiḥ ॥3-51-8॥

translations.english: Ravana in a rage took ten dreadful darts (looking) like the staff of death with a desire to crush the enemy.
